**[P2] Preserve containment when every clock sample is interrupted**

Using the midpoint leaves up to half the selected sampling window as epoch error. The added `[40, 10, 30]` stall case observes a 5 ms offset and deliberately skips parent containment, so scheduler or GC pauses can still place ordinary user spans outside their SDK parents. Retain the sample's lower and upper correlation bounds and use start-safe/end-safe boundaries (or otherwise clamp by the measured uncertainty), then assert containment for the stalled cases.
